scope: Japanese KEIRIN and legally recognized 250-race circumference lanes; preserve raw source measurement/serialization on every race record and never coerce one true circumference class into another.

standard_keirin_category_authority.verified_statement: KEIRIN.JP identifies four standard Japanese keirin bank-lap length types: 333.3m, 335m, 400m, and 500m.

special_250_race_authority.verified_statement: 250競走 (PIST6) uses a 250m bank and is a distinct public bicycle-racing format. It has been suspended since October 2025; Chiba City currently targets FY2030 for resumption.

lanes.raw_source_value_policy: Preserve 250 exactly and never pool into standard keirin circumference lanes without separately validated cross-format research.
lanes.research_handling: Retain historical evidence as a separate 250m/250競走 lane. Do not mix directly with standard keirin because race format, rider count, line rules and competition structure differ. Resume prospective capture only when authoritative 250-race operation resumes.

lanes.raw_source_value_policy: Preserve the source value exactly. Existing PRE artifacts may use nominal 333 or 333.33-style serialization; do not numerically overwrite the raw field.
lanes.research_handling: Continue PRE/outcome accumulation inside this circumference class; retain raw authoritative serialization per record.
